basic_info.description: Spacious 2 br 1 ba condo in the vibrant Mission District and neighbor Hayes Valley, Upper Market. Excellent location, walking distance to everything you need.     Welcoming floorplan, providing space for relaxation and entertainment. Elevator building with secure gated entry and 1 car parking included. Property is subjected to resale procedure. The City and County of San Francisco holds the right of first refusal. City Second Loan Program is available to qualified buyers on first come first serve basis. Visit http://sfmohcd.org/city-second-details for application and program information.
